note: Hour i is hour i of the year in UTC. Weather: a typical year (months from different years). Prices and household use: 2025.

sources.weather: EU JRC PVGIS 5.3, typical meteorological year, PVGIS-SARAH3 and ERA5, 2005-2023
sources.prices: NO2 day-ahead spot prices 2025, hvakosterstrommen.no (Nord Pool), NOK/kWh excl. VAT
sources.households: Elhub, hourly consumption of households in NO2, 2025, per metering point
sources.terrain: Kartverket NHM DTM (horizon of the shared plant)

office_roof.note: the existing office building's south-west roof slope, from the laser data
